title: <role>'s out
description: What the role <role> gives as it ends: its result, its last message, and its answers where it judges a work by questions. The role's part names this file.

result.description: The fixed word the role gives as it ends, by running python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lane/result.py <role> <result>, such as asks for a point to the person and done. The routes go on by this word, never by what the role writes.

reply.description: The role's last message. It begins with the line For the person: where it holds a point for the person, which the main conversation puts to them as given, one point a message. Otherwise it holds what the next role starts with, such as its run values, and nothing more.

answers.description: The answers of a role that judges a work by questions, in a file the role writes: each question in good, with the lines of the work that meet it, or in more, with good_when, and each point open that only the person can settle. Optional.

lines.description: Each line of the work that meets it, as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.

good_when.description: What the work's user gets once the work is good, in their terms, never how to make it, because the generator holds the sources and mends the work in its own way.

question.description: The question the point bears on, by its ID.

what.description: The point that only the person can settle.
